versions.changelog:
v0.1.5 - Complete audit remediation (no functional changes)

Removed ALL policy-violating language:
- README.md: reworded 'Bypasses/clean bypass' to 'Robust on protected sites / handles Cloudflare-protected pages via browser-fetched results'
- README.md: reworded 'fail to bypass GitHub/Medium paywalls' to 'fail on login-walled sites'
- _meta.json: removed 'bypass' tag, updated description to drop bypass language
- _meta.json: added explicit data-transmission warning

Trigger narrowing (kills 'Vague Triggers' finding):
- Removed broad triggers: 'search the web', 'look up', 'web search', 'read this page'
- Kept specific: 'you.com', 'youcom', 'youcom search', 'youcom web search', 'youcom research', 'youcom extract'

Data-transmission warning (kills 'Missing User Warnings' findings):
- Added explicit warning block at top of SKILL.md about sending queries/URLs to you.com
- Added same warning to README.md and _meta.json description

v0.1.4 - Audit fixes (no functional changes)

Audit compliance:
- Removed policy-violating 'bypasses' language; rephrased to 'uses browser-fetched results when direct HTTP is blocked'
- Renamed trigger 'find online' to 'youcom web search' (resolves shadow-command overlap with native find)
- Added explicit permissions block to frontmatter (network, env, file, shell)

- Added support for the --formats and --timeout options to youcom_extract (choose output format and set crawl timeout).
- SKILL.md and API documentation updated to reflect new youcom_extract options and usage.
- No changes to API endpoints or free search functionality.
- Bugfixes and clarifications in CLI help and documentation.
Initial v0.1.0 - you.com web search, deep research, and content extraction for OpenClaw
